SELECT 'cal' AS k, fiscal_year, CAST(fiscal_period AS VARCHAR) AS a, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) AS b, CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR) AS c, CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) AS d FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store', CAST(store_key AS VARCHAR), CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), store_name, city || '/' || region || '/' || format, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) || '..' || CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%Pit%' OR city ILIKE '%Pit%' OR store_id=102

calls.statement:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at, p.sku, p.category, f.sale_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT 'lines' AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_line, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, SUM(quantity) AS units, SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS test_units, SUM(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx FROM base
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, SUM(units_sold), NULL, NULL, MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_name) AS names
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku
LIMIT 8

SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units_in_period
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.sku IN (101624,101778,102244,102233,103670)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
